title: UI Component Variant Compiler
description: Verifies component visual variant matrix: token-only references, destructive semantic enforcement, all-mode coverage, prop axis completeness

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract component definition, variant axes, token references from design intent

pipeline.title: Verify Component Variants
pipeline.description: Run all gates: token-only refs, destructive semantics, mode coverage, prop coverage

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed variant artifact for component implementation

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: component-variant-spec.json exists with component name and variants array

gates.title: Token References Only
gates.description: All variant color values reference design token names, not raw values

gates.title: Destructive Semantic
gates.description: Variants with destructive/danger intent use the semantic destructive token

gates.title: All Modes Covered
gates.description: Each variant has visual properties defined for all declared theme modes

gates.title: Prop Coverage
gates.description: Every declared prop axis has at least one variant entry

gates.title: No Raw Values
gates.description: No hardcoded hex, rgb(), rgba(), or raw px values in variant visual properties

gates.title: No TODOs
gates.description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK in variant spec files

contracts.description: Structural requirements for a valid component visual variant matrix

error_codes.UCV002: Variant visual property uses non-token reference
error_codes.UCV003: Destructive-intent variant does not use destructive semantic token
error_codes.UCV004: Variant missing visual definition for a declared theme mode
error_codes.UCV005: Declared prop axis has no variant entry
error_codes.UCV006: Hardcoded hex/rgb/px value in variant visual properties
error_codes.UCV007: TODO/FIXME/HACK found in variant spec files
